'''S'Ten Gali Ak'Ar''' was the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] leader of the [[Gor'Jen'Ar]] resistance movement on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. A [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] by nature, she became a warrior and politician in exile to lead the Gor'Jen'Ar resistance movement. Relying on false identities, S'Ten Gali Ak'Ar lived among the people of [[Graith]].
